title: Crown Network
description: Crown Network is a small Minecraft network.
body:
### Crown Network Servers
Crown Network is a small Minecraft network.

On Crown Network you'll find these servers:

- Crown SMP
- Minigames
- Eventserver

``` 
You can return to the hub from any server using /hub.
We have a german community, but you can also join when you doesn't speak German!
```
